source_refs.note: 2. Swing of a Ball: a main subheading of 5.12 Uses of Bernoulli's principle, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: Jab gend spin ke saath phenki ya kick ki jaye (kitab ke mutabiq bowler gend ko ek taraf se chikna rakhta hai aur doosri taraf khurdari rehti hai), to gend ke ek taraf hawa tez aur doosri taraf aahista chalti hai. Bernoulli's equation ke mutabiq tez hawa kam pressure aur aahista hawa zyada pressure banati hai. Is pressure ke farq se ek sideways (ek side ki taraf) force paida hoti hai jise Magnus effect kehte hain, aur gend hawa mein mur jati hai.

blocks.alt: Hawa ki dhaar mein gend, hawa daen se baen chalti hai. Gend ke oopar streamlines qareeb (Faster air, lower pressure), neeche phaili hui (Slower air, higher pressure). Deflection force ka teer gend se oopar hai. Chhoti tasveer (Spinning ball) mein ghoomti gend ka rasta dashed seedhi line se oopar mur jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.18: Turbulent flow (ghoomti gend ke gird hawa ka flow) (kitab ki Figure 5.18 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan do alag cheezein mila deti hai. Magnus effect spin (ghoomne) se hota hai: ghoomti gend hawa ko apne saath ghumati hai, is liye ek taraf hawa tez aur doosri taraf aahista hoti hai, aur pressure ka farq gend ko morta hai (Fig. 5.18). Cricket ki gend ka ek taraf chikna aur doosri taraf khurdara hona swing ki alag wajah hai; woh Magnus effect nahi.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gend ke oopar hawa tez aur pressure kam hai, neeche hawa aahista aur pressure zyada; is farq se force (deflection force) gend ko oopar, yani kam pressure ki taraf, morti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne is tasveer (Fig. 5.18) ka caption ‘Turbulent flow’ likha hai, jo asal mein Fig. 5.13 ka caption hai. Yeh tasveer ghoomti gend ke gird hawa ka flow (Magnus effect) dikhati hai.
